decisions.communication_sequence: Separate intake meetings will be held with Jules and Kai individually before any joint restorative meeting is scheduled. Any subsequent joint restorative discussion will include a neutral facilitator, consistent with the prior promise disclosed by Nadia.
decisions.restorative_process: A joint restorative meeting between Jules and Kai will be scheduled only after both separate intake meetings are completed.
